items.title: Willie J. Humphrey Interview, 1979-11-29
items.q: Of course the Japanese is very nice. He plays a little better in the union skills.

ctx.x: You can just get the union skills. Of course the Japanese is very nice. He plays a little better in the union skills. I don't think I'd want to work every night at this age. I think I could live without it. Not as well as you and your dad and your mama. Because you're not mine, huh? No. But you ain't got nothing to worry about. Not yet? No. You've got a nice mother, nice daddy. How old are you? Twenty-five.
